Senior Product Designer, Autonomous Mobility & Delivery Experience Autonomous vehicles are reshaping how people and goods move through cities. At Uber, we're building the experiences that make autonomous mobility feel intuitive, trustworthy, and seamlessly integrated into everyday life.

As a Product Designer on the Autonomous Mobility & Delivery Experience team, you'll define the future of how riders discover, understand, request, and complete autonomous trips. You'll work across the end-to-end journey, turning emerging technology into experiences that millions of people can confidently use.

This is a 0-to-1 environment where you must make big decisions without perfect information and own the outcomes. You'll need to navigate high-stakes ambiguity, balance near-term execution with long-term vision, and advocate for the user in a high-speed, technical landscape.

If you think critically and are motivated by the challenge of real-world impact at a global scale, this is where you will grow. What You'll Do Design end-to-end experiences across the autonomous rider journey, from discovery and booking through pickup, ride, support, and beyond.

Shape product strategy alongside Product, Engineering, Operations, Research, Data Science, and partner teams. Translate complex technical capabilities and operational constraints into simple, intuitive customer experiences.

Build trust by designing experiences that help riders understand what autonomous vehicles are doing, what to expect, and how to interact with them. Develop scalable interaction patterns and frameworks that can support multiple autonomous vehicle partners and future capabilities.

Prototype and communicate ideas quickly to drive alignment and accelerate decision making. Use research, experimentation, and data to continuously improve the rider experience. Raise the quality bar through systems thinking, strong craft, and thoughtful design execution.

Basic qualifications 5+ years of professional product design experience, with a proven track record of shipping, scaling, and iterating on high-quality consumer products. A portfolio demonstrating strategic thinking alongside exceptional design craft.

Strong product thinking with the ability to balance user needs, business goals, and technical constraints. Demonstrated proficiency with AI-first design workflows, alongside exceptional interaction design, visual design, and prototyping skills.

Strong communication and storytelling skills with cross-functional partners and leadership and experience influencing product strategy beyond individual features. Preferred Qualifications Experience with transportation, mapping, mobility, logistics, robotics, or AI-powered products.

Experience building and implementing components within a global, scalable design system. Experience designing physical-digital experiences, including automotive HMI, in-vehicle experiences, or other connected products. Proven ability to collaborate with user researchers and data scientists to drive experimentation and A/B testing.

Deep expertise in AI-native design workflows and complex technical prototyping, including building custom tools, agents, and production-ready implementations. Why Join This Team Autonomous mobility represents one of the biggest shifts in transportation in decades.

You'll have the opportunity to define experiences that don't yet have industry standards, influence how millions of people interact with autonomous technology, and help shape the future of mobility on a global scale. About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

s.h: Get to Know Our Design Team
s.t:
The Design team is a diverse group of product designers and researchers that help to build Agoda’s products from our home office in Bangkok. Being a product-driven company, we constantly partner with product managers and engineers to understand user problems and design workflows, interactions, and visual interfaces.

There is always an opportunity for growth here. Focus on your craft to improve or expand your skill set, or step into a managerial role and flex your talents as a designer and driver of team projects. This is a great time to join a team that’s small enough to be scrappy and hands on, yet big enough to influence change and product strategy.

At Agoda, we offer a range of travel products – including accommodations, flights, and activities – and are building the next generation of travel experiences to help customers plan and book their entire trip. Join our design team to shape how users engage with recommendations, making them personalized, contextual, and relevant.

As a Product Designer L2 / Senior Product Designer, Trip Marketing , you’ll lead the design of cross-sell and recommendation across all of our user touchpoints. You’ll partner closely with engineers, user researchers, and product managers to design interactions that feel human, helpful, and seamless.

This is a hands-on role where you’ll set UX strategy, drive complex design initiatives, and ensure our experiences are intuitive, scalable, and grounded in user needs.

· 6+ years of full-time experience as a product designer for digital or web-based products; in-house experience highly preferred.

· Create visually stunning, intuitive, and delightful interfaces, and independently deliver pixel-perfect UI and seamless interactions. You sweat the details and care deeply about craft.

· You are highly experienced in UI design, with deep knowledge of design patterns and a creative approach to solving problems through user interfaces.

· Proficient in both quantitative and qualitative research, with hands-on experience running user interviews, synthesizing findings, and generating actionable insights to inform design decisions.

· Take full ownership of the design process for a dedicated scrum, from discovery to delivery. You’ll set the design vision, define the user experience, and ensure high-quality execution.

· Partner with Product managers to shape product vision and roadmap. You’ll use data, research, and business context to inform your design decisions, always balancing user needs with business goals.

· Has experience of managing multiple stakeholders within an agile development process

· Strong communicator who can articulate design rationale, influence stakeholders, and build trust across disciplines.

· A strong portfolio of work that demonstrates your design thinking, process, and solutions showcasing beautiful, user-centered web and mobile product design.

s.h: Day to day, it looks like
s.t:
· Running discovery phases and helping define product requirements

· Testing prototypes and hypotheses with users to collect feedback

· Present your work to peers and leadership, async and in-person

· Take part in weekly design critiques, workshops, all hands, and squad meetings

· Think and write about your process and detailing your decisions

· Champion cohesion and consistency in UX design that unites a growing family of products/features

· Be a strategic leader with a vision in how to implement experiences that represent the most customer-centric intersection between design, business, content, and technology.

Product Designer L2/ Senior Product Designer at Agoda means you have a track record of:

· You work alongside your design partners in driving discovery and ideation workshops and align the group around a vision and approach

· You have a track record of crafting sophisticated flows and customer journeys

· You can think and craft at a system level, not just interface elements or pages

· You’ll regularly make use of your soft skills: listening, negotiating, decision-making

· You can balance multiple priorities and successfully deliver in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

· Effective articulation of ideas and design solutions

· Expressing feedback with kindness and candor

· Tolerance for ambiguity and healthy curiosity

· Translation of quantitative & qualitative insights into design decisions

· Contribution to our culture: motivation, optimism, quality, integrity

About Gusto

At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.

All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy .

AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

The HR Expertise pod builds Gusto's knowledge and guidance layer — the part of the product that makes a small business feel like it has an expert HR team in its corner, not just a software tool. That layer is increasingly AI-driven: AI-generated guidance, AI-drafted documents, AI workflows for human HR advisors, and the compliance knowledge graph underneath all of it.

This role sits at the intersection of service design and AI product design. You'll shape how Gusto delivers HR expertise across two sides of a service: the small business owner asking for help, and the HR expert delivering it. You'll design AI-assisted experiences in a domain where mistakes have legal consequences for our customers — which is exactly why judgment, preference, and craft matter here in a way they don't in lower-stakes products.

The HR Experiences team at Gusto wants to make HR a reliable support for small businesses. They create smart guidance, tools for advisors, and a compliance layer. This helps provide top-quality HR support in a way that feels simple and easy to access.

Gusto Design is operating in an AI-native way, and HRX is one of the teams encouraging that envelope hardest. We expect this role to bring fluency with AI in two directions:

· AI in your workflow. Using AI to accelerate exploration, prototyping, research synthesis, and content drafting — so the team moves faster without losing craft.

· AI in the product. You will design the user experience for AI-generated outputs. This means showing uncertainty clearly and displaying errors in a user-friendly way. You will also ensure that users can keep control when AI suggestions differ from HR best practices. Additionally, you will create moments for customers or advisors to correct the system if necessary.

· Shape the end-to-end experience of HR Assist, HR Partner Console, Compliance Intelligence, and HR Documents — four AI-powered product surfaces that share a common knowledge layer.

· Lead service design across the two-sided product: journey maps, service blueprints, and operational handoffs between AI systems, human advisors, and small business customers.

· Make judgment calls about AI outputs — when to ship them, when to override them, when to put a human in the loop, and how to articulate why a generated direction is or isn't good enough.

· Define how trust, uncertainty, graceful failure, and human override show up across these surfaces — patterns that will inform AI experience design across the broader HRX org.

· Co-lead product direction with PM, engineering, and data partners across four teams. You'll be a co-owner of strategy, not a downstream executor of it.

· Frame ambiguous problems and align partners around a clear direction, often before the data is in.

· Conduct and direct research with customers and HR partners to validate these experiences in a high-stakes compliance domain.

· You've shipped AI-powered experiences to production — not prototypes — and can speak concretely to how you handled uncertainty, errors, and human override.

· Experience in service design for products that involve two sides or multiple stakeholders. You should have real experience with journey mapping and service blueprinting, including operational handoffs, not just in workshop exercises.

· You can evaluate and direct AI-generated design and content — knowing when to use it, when to override it, and how to raise the bar. In a compliance domain, "wrong" isn't just bad UX; it's legal exposure for our customers.

· Cross-functional judgment to co-lead direction with PM, engineering, and data — and hold your position when the right answer is unpopular.

· Comfort with ambiguity — you frame the problem, scope the work, and advance forward without waiting for perfect information.

· 5+ years of product design experience owning shipped work in B2B SaaS, with well-developed craft across web. (Figma and a modern design toolchain assumed.)

· Experience in a consequential domain — HR, compliance, fintech, legal, or healthcare — where the cost of being wrong is real.

· Helped lead a team's shift to AI-native workflows, and can speak to what changed about the work itself, not just the tools.

· Background contributing to AI governance, evaluation practices, or AI experience design patterns.

· Experience designing for internal operators or expert users (advisors, agents, support staff) alongside customer-facing surfaces.

About Toast

Our focus is on building the platform that helps restaurants adapt, take control, and get back to what they do best: building the businesses they love.

And because our technology is purpose-built for restaurants, by restaurant people, restaurants can trust that we'll deliver on their needs for today while investing in experiences that will power their restaurant of the future. We build experiences that help make operating and growing a business and delighting customers easier and scalable.

It's why tens of thousands of businesses love Toast.

Toast IQ is our AI assistant, designed to give restaurant operators smarter insights, deeper personalization, and the ability to take action across the Toast ecosystem. Building on this foundation, we're investing heavily in agentic capabilities by giving operators the ability to delegate real work to Toast IQ , not just view insights.

We're entering an exciting phase of expanding this product to tens of thousands of businesses. That expansion depends on getting the core interaction patterns right once, and getting the whole company aligned behind them. That's where you come in.

As the Principal Product Designer for Toast IQ Core, you will define the interaction language for agentic experiences at Toast including the patterns, behaviors, and components that every team building on top of Toast IQ will use. This isn't a single-surface design role.

Your job is to figure out what "good" looks like when a restaurant operator moves from viewing a dashboard to delegating work to an AI agent, and then to get product, engineering, and design teams across the company to build on that foundation instead of inventing their own.

You'll set direction hands-on, in Figma, in prototypes, in critique, and through influence: building the conviction and relationships needed for other teams to adopt a pattern language you define, not just execute your own roadmap. You'll partner closely with product, engineering, data science, go-to-market, and conversational and service designers to define the future of intelligence at Toast.

This is a highly visible, individual-contributor role for someone who wants outsized leverage over how an entire product area feels and works.

· Systems ownership: Define and evangelize the core interaction patterns, behaviors, and component language for agentic experiences across Toast IQ. Building a system that other designers and teams design on top of, not just shipping your own features.

· Organizational influence: Build conviction across product, engineering, and GTM leadership for a UX point of view they didn't already have. Agentic UX at Toast's scale is largely undefined territory, you're not executing an established pattern, you're setting one and getting others to follow it.

· Leadership: Proven track record leading high-impact design initiatives at a principal level: defining new interaction paradigms (not just refining existing ones) and driving their adoption beyond your own immediate team.

· Execution: Lead end-to-end design for core UX/UI within Toast's AI ecosystem across web and native mobile, driving prototyping and experimentation for AI features like memory, personalization, agentic workflows, and actions.

· AI-native design experience: Have shipped a 0-to-1 AI or agentic product experience, not just designed features that use AI under the hood. Deep understanding of emerging AI use cases and tooling, plus foundational user-centered design, usability, and accessibility standards.

· Pro-research: Proven ability and desire to conduct and coordinate data analysis, user research, and usability testing to inform design decisions.

· Tools: Proficiency with emerging AI tools (Claude, Replit, V0, etc.) is essential, as well as design tools like Figma, Miro, and other collaborative platforms.

· Partner collaboration: Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively across product, engineering, GTM, and data science to define requirements and align on goals.

· Mentorship: Mentor designers at all levels and act as a design-quality bar-raiser across the org, fostering a culture of innovation and AI adoption.

What we'll ask to see

Case studies that show you defining a new interaction paradigm , not just refining an existing one, and driving adoption of it beyond your own team or product surface. We're evaluating systems thinking and organizational influence as much as visual craft.

You are a dynamic leader with proven impact in previous roles who is ready and willing to take on new challenges! You’re excited to join the remotely distributed group of product designers, user researchers, design ops leaders, and product managers that compose the Toast Design team. You embody the tenets that drive Toast’s Design practice:

· You have a founder’s mentality: and exhibit ownership of outcomes over outputs. You own the quality and outcomes associated with full end to end experiences.

· You lift others up: and recognize you don’t have to be a manager to engage and exhibit true leadership. You find formal ways to utilize your personal skill set to uplevel those around you.

· You drive action through influence: and appreciate that building trusting and productive relationships with those around you is integral to driving action. You build strong relationships to enact influence throughout the entirety of the area of the business you work within.

· You build strong perspectives: and guide yourself and your teams to make good decisions quickly and often. You collaboratively make well informed decisions with large scale impact across the area of the business you work within.

· You raise the bar: and commit to continually improving the technical skills relevant to your role. You find large scale, creative methods to continually build your skill set.

Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company. We free people and agents to ship what’s next.

For more than a decade, Vercel has shaped how the web is built. As the team behind Next.js, v0, and AI SDK, we create products that help builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

Now, software is entering a new era, and the next generation of products will not just be used by people. They will be built, extended, and operated by agents.

We are building the platform for that future, trusted by companies like OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide . Whether you’re building our products, supporting our customers, growing our community, or shaping our story, you’ll help define what comes next.

You’ll help define Growth Design at Vercel and shape the complete self-serve journey: signup, onboarding, first project and deployment, adoption, conversion, expansion, and retention. The work spans people, agents, and the handoffs between them.

You’ll report into Product Design and work closely with Growth Product, Engineering and Data. You’ll have the authority and support to move from an observed problem to a working prototype, shipped experience, and measured result.

Vercel gives you unlimited access to leading LLMs and in-house tools that make product data easier to explore. If a tool limits the work, you can partner directly with its builders or improve it yourself.

Sobre a vaga
Buscamos uma pessoa Product Designer Júnior para apoiar a construção de experiências digitais centradas no usuário, atuando de forma colaborativa em todo o ciclo de produto, desde o Discovery até a Evolução da solução em produção.
Essa pessoa trabalhará próxima de Product Managers, Tech Leads e demais Designers, contribuindo com pesquisas, análises, prototipação, documentação e acompanhamento da implementação, desenvolvendo sua capacidade de transformar problemas em soluções relevantes para usuários e negócio.
